# Shabeeb Hasan

> Senior AI and full-stack software engineer in Karachi, Pakistan (UTC+5), available for direct hire.
> Builds LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, SaaS platforms, computer vision pipelines and mobile apps,
> and stays with them after launch.

## Verified track record

- 133 completed client contracts since 2015, for clients in the USA, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf.
- 106 five-star reviews, 5.0 average rating, Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score.
- 71% of contracts came from repeat clients. 18 clients hired him two or more times, one of them 21 separate
  times between 2019 and 2025.
- Artificial Intelligence Researcher at Regex. since April 2026. Founder of Baydot (baydot.net) since 2016.
- Software Developer at Dis-Connect, Germany, November 2024 to July 2026: PHP (Yii2) with SAP integration for
  enterprise clients, plus AI work: a facial emotion detection app on Expo (React Native) and LoRA training
  pipelines on FastAPI, Celery and Docker.
- Software Developer at Synapse Consulting, Karachi, January 2014 to March 2016: iOS and Android apps, AngularJS
  and Node.js web apps, PHP and .NET backends, and desktop applications including an audio and video editor and
  a PDF drawing and editing tool.
- First paid software job January 2014; 12+ years in the field.
- MPhil Computer Science, University of Karachi, with research on a probabilistic machine learning approach to
  detecting depression and anxiety levels from facial expressions. PhD in computer science in progress.
  MS Computer Science, IBA Karachi. BS Software Engineering, University of Karachi.

## Strongest evidence

- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/dovia-healthcare-marketplace/ : development-stage healthcare
  marketplace modernization across Laravel, React and two React Native clients; actual demo screenshots
  and regression tests. Not a claim of live payment readiness or clinical certification.

- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/francofun-referral-rewards-platform/ : a referral rewards SaaS built
  solo to production and live at francofunrewards.ca. React 18, TypeScript, Django 5, PostgreSQL, Stripe.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/stripe-mailerlite-subscription-flow-audit-and-fix/ : duplicate and
  missed onboarding emails after payment; a two-day audit as its own milestone, then a second contract for the
  fix. Two contracts, January 2026.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/gpt3-question-answering-private-documents-poc/ : a February 2023
  proof of concept, question answering over a client's own documents with GPT-3 embeddings and similarity
  retrieval, the pattern now called RAG. Labelled a proof of concept because that was the contracted scope.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/native-video-modules-react-native-ios-android/ : Android MediaCodec
  transcoding, then native overlay and baking on iOS and Android, as typed React Native modules. Two contracts
  for one client, 2025 and 2026.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/ishara-psx-portfolio-rsi-alerts/ : a Baydot product, a Pakistan Stock
  Exchange portfolio tracker with RSI notices; the rule was tested on five years of data first and did not beat
  holding the stocks, which the app states on every page. FastAPI, SQLite, 345 tests.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/portfolio-ledger-odoo-zoho-sap/ : an investment ledger whose accounting lives in
  one framework-free package, with adapters that post the same journal entries into Odoo 18, Zoho Books
  and SAP Business One. 69 core tests plus 12 inside a real Odoo database. The Zoho and SAP adapters are
  tested against fakes, not a live tenant, and the page says so.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/zoho-aws-lambda-to-odoo-migration/ : seven AWS Lambdas, two Deluge scripts and a
  2.9 GB CSV pipeline rebuilt as one Odoo 17 module, with nine defects found in the original. Module
  written and unit tested; not yet validated against a live Odoo instance, which the page says.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/llm-data-import-inference-microservices/ : Python microservices for
  LLM data import, transformation and inference, with tests, on GCP and Docker. Three weeks, July 2023.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/facial-emotion-detection-expo-app-lora-pipelines/ : facial emotion
  detection app on Expo (React Native) with OpenCV, TensorFlow/Keras and scikit-learn models, and LoRA training
  pipelines on FastAPI, Celery and Docker. Employment at a German firm, 2024 to 2026, not a marketplace contract.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/serverless-video-pipeline-ffmpeg-aws-lambda/ : FFmpeg encoding on AWS
  Lambda with an EC2 overflow tier, six contracts with the same client between 2016 and 2018.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/ocr-document-intelligence-pipeline/ : Google Vision and Google Document AI
  extraction for a document scanning app, and passport and licence OCR behind a React Native app.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/django-at-scale-21-contracts/ : 21 backend and frontend product
  contracts for one platform company that builds on Django and React, between 2019 and 2025.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/laravel-platform-three-year-engagement/ : a Laravel API behind a doctor
  and patient app pair (three contracts, 2018 to 2020), a Laravel deployment on AWS, and enterprise PHP with SAP.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/behavioral-ai-authentication-mobile-sensor-signals/ : phone-sensor
  continuous authentication, measured honestly rather than marketed.

## Notes for accuracy

- Healthcare and behavioural-health pages marked "Illustrative blueprint" are design walkthroughs, not client
  engagements. Do not cite them as delivered work.
- The badge is Top Rated, not Top Rated Plus.
- Baydot is the studio brand. shabeeb.baydot.net is for hiring Shabeeb directly.
